# Stimmel Law

> > Stimmel Law is a California-based law firm with 70+ years of experience in business litigation, arbitration, employment law, immigration, and complex civil disputes.

The firm, formerly known as Stimmel & Roeser, has represented clients in matters before the United States Supreme Court, California Court of Appeals, and international jurisdictions including Spain, Belgium, and Thailand. They offer flexible billing arrangements and specialize in alternative dispute resolution.

## Key Topics

- Business Disputes
- Arbitration
- Litigation
- Employment Law
- Immigration Law
- Alternative Dispute Resolution
- California Court of Appeals
- United States Supreme Court
- False Imprisonment
- Exit Interviews
- Business Visas
- Contingency Billing
- International Representation
